const value:string|number='hello';
const arrow=()=>value.toUpperCase();
const object={text(){return value.toUpperCase();}};
class C{method(){return typeof value==='string'?value.toUpperCase():'';}}
function outer(){let local:string|number='world';return ()=>local.toUpperCase();}
console.log(arrow(),object.text(),new C().method(),outer()());
